_comment: The `build` field's resolution order and its accepted revision vocabulary.
docs/CONTRACTS.md prose says the same thing; this is the machine-readable
half, so a change to the order or the vocabulary moves a fixture instead of
Added 2026-09-07 with the npm package. `npm` is new: before it, an installed
copy fell through to `unknown`, because there is no repository to ask. That
made the field worthless in the one place provenance is hardest to
reconstruct afterwards -- an installed binary cannot know its commit, but
'this is a published build' is true, checkable, and more than nothing.
Order is significant: the first rule that produces a value wins.
Changed 2026-10-31: an installed copy never asks git. The git rule used to run
first, in whatever work tree the install sat in, so a project-local or CI
`npm i` stamped the PROJECT's commit on every record as gnomon's build -- a
wrong provenance, which is worse than none. `package` is new: the release job
writes `gnomonBuild` into gnomon-core's package.json before packing, so an
installed release names its tag and commit. `git` now applies only in

resolution_order.when: the environment variable is set and non-blank
resolution_order.note: release archives ship it in a GNOMON_BUILD file; CI can export it

resolution_order.when: the harness runs from inside a node_modules tree and its package.json carries a non-blank gnomonBuild
resolution_order.revision: that value, verbatim (the release job writes <tag>-<short sha>)

resolution_order.when: the harness runs from inside a node_modules tree without a gnomonBuild stamp
resolution_order.note: git is never asked here: it would answer for the work tree the install sits in, not for gnomon

resolution_order.when: outside node_modules, and git's top level is gnomon's own checkout (it holds packages/gnomon-core/src/build.ts)
resolution_order.revision: <short sha>, suffixed -dirty when the worktree has uncommitted changes

must_never: end with a bare '+' — a missing revision is said, never implied
claim a commit for a tree with uncommitted changes
name a commit of a repository other than gnomon's own
